objective: Open your pack and wield the Bronze hatchet.
Chop a marked tree in Survival Wood for logs.
Use your tinderbox on the logs to light a fire.
Use the Small net at the marked fishing spot.
Cook the fish on your fire (light another if it has burnt out).
Enter the Mine Gatehouse by its south gate and climb down the shaft in the winch house.
Mine a copper rock with your pickaxe.
Follow the offshoot south-east and mine a tin rock.
Smelt copper and tin into a bronze bar.
Forge the highlighted Bronze dagger at the anvil.
